description:
Surfaced by bd:JMAP-ly0n.8. The workspace AGENTS.md 'Security testing' section mandates two complementary canary patterns for credential-grade secret literals:

1. Per-type Debug redaction canary — covers {:?} / format!("{value:?}") leaks. SpaceInvite has this at crate-jmap-chat-types/src/space.rs (test: space_invite_debug_does_not_leak_code).

2. Log-capture canary — covers Display / tracing::* leaks. Required when the crate emits tracing::* events with arguments that interpolate a secret-bearing type. SpaceInvite.code is currently NOT covered by pattern 2 anywhere in the workspace.

Reference harness: crate-jmap-base-client/tests/common/log_capture.rs and crate-jmap-base-client/tests/log_redaction.rs.

Scope:
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/common/log_capture.rs (mirror the base-client harness)
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/space_invite_log_redaction.rs:
  - Install thread-local buffering tracing subscriber
  - Exercise the Space/join code path (the canonical site for SpaceInvite.code interpolation) including success and failure variants
  - Assert the captured buffer contains no canary code literal regardless of which level / format the future contributor used

If chat-server does not currently emit tracing::* events on the Space/join path, the canary is still required: it tripwires against a future contributor adding instrumentation that includes the code in the captured argument set. Workspace AGENTS.md framing: 'When adding a new type or a new logging call site that crosses these boundaries, file a follow-up bead if the canary test cannot land in the same commit.'

Out of scope: redacting Display impls in chat-types itself. SpaceInvite has no Display impl by design — Display formatting on the whole struct fails to compile, which is fine. The risk is access to .code as a String, not Display on the struct.
title: Add log-capture canary for SpaceInvite.code in jmap-chat-server (pattern 2 per workspace security policy)
